channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Candidato investigado acompanha Flávio Bolsonaro em barqueata em Angra
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) attended a campaign event in Angra dos Reis alongside Renato, a federal deputy candidate under police investigation. The appearance drew criticism for associating the lawmaker with investigated figures.

item.title: Ex-comandante da FAB chama de ‘leviandade’ fala de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre suposto apoio a Lula
item.description: Former Air Force Commander, Brigadier Carlos de Almeida Baptista Junior, called Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) statements about alleged military support for President Lula 'recklessness'. The reaction occurs amid the 2026 presidential election context, generating tension between the Armed Forces and the Bolsonaro political camp.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lança jogo do Tesouraço
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro launched a game inspired by the 'Tesouraço' proposal to reduce government spending, announced on Gamer Day. The game lets users cut items portrayed as petista expenses, featuring characters based on Jair Bolsonaro, Alfredo Gaspar, and Flávio. He also emphasized support for the Brazilian gaming industry.

item.title: TRE-SP rejeita pedido do PT para remover posts de Tarcísio
item.description: The São Paulo Electoral Court rejected the PT's request to remove Tarcísio de Freitas' posts about the Barretos Bull Rodeo Festival. Haddad's campaign accused the governor of turning the event into a publicity stunt, but election judges deemed his presence legitimate.

item.title: Haddad: apoio de ex-secretários tucanos tem “carga simbólica muito grande”
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) emphasized the symbolic support of 24 former PSDB secretaries, highlighting democratic convergences between the parties. He criticized privatizations and Tarcísio's administration, reinforcing unity against the far-right.

item.title: Tralli e Renata entrevistam Augusto Cury, candidato a presidente pelo Avante
item.description: The Tralli and Renata program interviews Augusto Cury, candidate for president from Avante, between August 24 and 29, broadcast live by Globo platforms. The interviews cover the top six candidates in the Quaest poll released on August 14, including figures such as Lula, Romeu Zema, and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Campanha de Lula vai ao TSE por discurso de Flávio em Barretos
item.description: Lula's campaign filed lawsuits with the TSE against Flávio Bolsonaro over his speech at the Barretos rodeo, requesting the annulment of his ticket and ineligibility for alleged misuse of economic power and deepfake usage. The coalition also demands the removal of videos linking Lula to the word 'thief' and penalties for improper publications.

item.title: Ex-chefe da FAB chama de ‘leviandade’ fala de Flávio sobre apoio a Lula
item.description: Former FAB commander Carlos de Almeida Junior rejected accusations from senator Flávio Bolsonaro that he had supported Lula's reelection, calling the statements 'levity'. The military officer claimed his words were distorted and that Flávio used the remark to avoid answering direct questions. The incident occurs amid growing tensions between government figures and opponents in the 2026 electoral landscape.

item.title: Quaest no Pará: Lula, 37%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 29%
item.description: The Quaest poll in Pará shows Lula at 37% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 29% in the presidential race. Ineligible candidate Pablo Marçal appears with 2% when included. Lula's government approval is 47%, with 46% disapproval.

item.title: Ex-comandante da FAB rebate Flávio e diz não fazer campanha para Lula
item.description: Former FAB commander Carlos de Almeida Baptista Júnior denied Flávio Bolsonaro's claims that he supports Lula, calling the allegations 'frivolous'. The dispute involves testimonies about alleged anti-democratic acts during the Bolsonaro administration and mutual criticisms during the presidential campaign.

item.title: Fui o 1º a criticar a esquerda, diz Caiado em propaganda eleitoral
item.description: Caiado claims in electoral campaign that he was the first to criticize the left and never associated with criminals, reinforcing his opposition to the PT and denouncing previous governments' omission in fighting crime.

item.title: Nikolas Ferreira rebate fala de Lula sobre garis: "Trabalho digno"
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira criticized President Lula for describing garbage collectors as a 'very poor profession', emphasizing that their work is dignified and essential. Nikolas argued that all professions should be valued, especially those keeping the streets clean.

item.title: Lula e Flávio trocam farpas em primeiro programa eleitoral na TV
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro exchanged barbs in their first televised election program, with mutual criticisms and proposal presentations. Lula highlighted his trajectory and attacked Flávio over corruption allegations, while Flávio criticized Lula's management and appealed to female voters.

item.title: Qual é o horário do Jornal Nacional? Veja que horas começa a entrevista de Augusto Cury
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) is the last candidate to be interviewed by TV Globo in the 2026 presidential election series. The live interview will air on Saturday, August 29, at 9:20 PM, following the start of Jornal Nacional at 8:55 PM. Notable candidates include Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Caiado, Zema, and others.

item.title: Renan Santos defende tecnologia para reduzir fila do SUS e nova reforma trabalhista
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate from Missão to the Presidency, proposed during a campaign event in São Paulo the implementation of an electronic single medical record with AI in the SUS to reduce waiting lines and speed up care. He also advocated for a new labor reform targeting app and informal workers, with a contract model based on the sale of hours and reduced contributions to social security. His proposals aim to modernize the public sector and increase labor formalization.

item.title: Lula rebate Flávio sobre mudanças climáticas: "Amadorismo irresponsável"
item.description: Lula criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's approach to climate change, calling it 'irresponsible amateurism' to address global warming solely through basic sanitation. The president highlighted R$23 billion in sanitation investments but stressed that climate action requires broader, science-based measures. Flávio previously denied global warming in 2019.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro apoia exploração de petróleo na Foz do Amazonas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro endorsed oil exploration in the Amazonas River mouth, emphasizing environmental responsibility, and proposed completing the Angra 3 nuclear plant with private investment during a motorcycle rally in Angra dos Reis.

item.title: Em 1º programa eleitoral, Flávio Bolsonaro faz aceno ao público gamer
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro wore an esports team t-shirt during his first campaign broadcast, drawing criticism for targeting the gamer community and using a branded image without permission.

item.title: Governo Lula prevê aporte de R$ 6 bilhões nos Correios
item.description: The Lula government plans to inject R$ 6 billion into the postal service in the 2027 budget, as announced by Minister of Planning Bruno Moretti. The funds will be part of the Annual Budget Bill to be sent to Congress next Monday, the 31st.

item.title: Augusto Cury na Globo ao vivo: que horas começa a entrevista no JN?
item.description: Augusto Cury, candidate from Avante, is the last interviewed in TV Globo's series on the 2026 presidential elections. The live interview takes place this Saturday, August 29, at 9:20 PM, right after the start of Jornal Nacional at 8:55 PM. The broadcast will be hosted by César Tralli and Renata Vasconcellos, available on TV Globo, GloboNews, and G1.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se encontra com ministro da Justiça de El Salvador neste domingo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro meets with El Salvador's Justice Minister to discuss replicating the Bukele security model in Brazil. The meeting highlights his alignment with the Central American nation and advocacy for strategies such as states of exception and federal prisons.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que Flávio ‘já prestou e vai continuar prestando esclarecimentos’ sobre ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas defended Flávio Bolsonaro regarding 'Dark Horse' funding controversies, stating he has clarified and will continue to do so. Both will participate in joint electoral programs, reinforcing their alliance for the elections.

item.title: Justiça marca audiência de conciliação entre governo e Discord
item.description: Federal Court scheduled conciliation hearing between federal government and Discord following public civil action after 13-year-old girl's death in Naviraí, attributed to suicide induction via platform. ANPD identified failures in minor protection, while Discord acknowledged security system flaws and requested additional time to comply with measures.

item.title: Augusto Cury é de direita ou de esquerda?
item.description: Augusto Cury, running for President with Avante, states he does not identify with left or right, positioning himself as a centrist. He criticizes political polarization in Brazil, arguing issues like violence, education, and unemployment have no ideological color. His campaign has gained significant digital traction with millions of followers and increased search interest.

item.title: A reclamação de Gonet sobre as tentativas de delação de Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet expresses disinterest in Daniel Vorcaro's plea bargain proposal, former owner of Banco Master, due to restrictions and conditions set by the banker. Vorcaro, arrested since March, denies corruption attempts against Central Bank employees, but the plea bargain strategy faces obstacles, including the upcoming elections and questions about the legality of plea agreements in the Supreme Court.

item.title: Em primeiro programa eleitoral na TV, Lula aposta em trajetória e propostas, e Flávio mira mulheres e segurança
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro used their first TV campaign programs to present distinct strategies: Lula highlighted his trajectory and pledges such as income tax exemption up to R$ 5,000, while Flávio focused on public security and the economy, aiming to appeal to female voters.

item.title: Jet sky dos Bombeiros é atingido por barco durante "barqueata" de Flávio
item.description: During a boat parade in Angra dos Reis, a fire department jet ski was hit by a vessel, leading to the rescue of firefighters from the sea. Flávio Bolsonaro advocated for the completion of the Angra 3 Nuclear Power Plant with private investment and the streamlining of environmental licenses to boost local development.

item.title: Flávio entende de meio ambiente tanto quanto de física quântica, diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) criticized Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) following his statements on climate change, calling him a 'fraud' and saying he 'understands climate change as much as quantum physics'. The exchange occurred after the Jornal Nacional interview, where Haddad attacked Flávio's credibility on environmental issues. Haddad used sarcasm to describe the senator's stance on climate change.

item.title: Flávio diz que buscará setor privado para concluir Angra 3
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro proposed involving the private sector to complete the Angra 3 Nuclear Power Plant, stalled since 2015 and costing R$1 billion annually. He also advocated for environmental licensing approval and oil exploration in the Amazon mouth.

item.title: Silvia Abravanel usa Silvio Santos para pedir votos e é detonada
item.description: Silvia Abravanel, a PSD candidate for federal deputy, used images of her late father Silvio Santos in campaign ads, sparking backlash over accusations of exploiting the iconic TV host's legacy. The former SBT presenter declared over R$47 million in assets to the Electoral Court and faced negative online commentary regarding the political use of her inheritance. The incident underscores polarization around celebrity-style politicians.

item.title: Flávio participa de motociata e barqueata em Angra; veja imagens
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), presidential candidate, took part in a motorcycle rally and boat parade in Angra dos Reis (RJ), where he emphasized the need to reduce bureaucracy and environmental restrictions. During the event, he held a live stream and highlighted support for Jair Bolsonaro, with appearances by allies including Douglas Ruas, Carlos Portinho, and Alfredo Gaspar.

item.title: Flávio faz “barqueata” e defende apoio privado para concluir Angra 3
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held a boat rally in Angra dos Reis for his campaign, advocating for the completion of the Angra 3 Nuclear Plant with private investment, alongside proposals to unlock environmental licenses and oil concessions. He emphasized infrastructure investments, particularly in the Northeast, and reinforced policies for energy resource exploitation.

item.title: Dr. Furlan tem 60,3% e Clécio, 33,1%, em 2º turno no Amapá
item.description: A Paraná Pesquisas survey released on August 29, 2026 shows Dr. Furlan (PSD) leading with 60.3% against Clécio Luis (União Brasil) at 33.1% in a hypothetical gubernatorial runoff in Amapá. The poll interviewed 1,080 voters from August 26 to 28, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro participa de barqueata em Angra dos Reis e diz 'apostar' no Nordeste nesta eleição
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro participated in a boat parade in Angra dos Reis, where he spoke about defeating the PT and emphasized his strategy in the Northeast, highlighting investments in gas and oil. During the event, he displayed a photo of Jair Bolsonaro with the presidential sash and engaged with supporters. The campaign continues with a narrative focused on regional and energy development.

item.title: Ato de Lula em Belo Horizonte tem manifestação de petistas insatisfeitos
item.description: At an event in Belo Horizonte, Lula faced protests from dissatisfied PT members over campaign resource distribution but promised the approval of the 6×1 work shift. The event featured Senate candidates and government ministers, emphasizing women's role in politics.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fez simulação de bancada e usou a própria esposa como entrevistadora antes de sabatina
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro conducted mock interviews with his wife Fernanda as interviewer during intensive preparation for the TV Globo interview. The strategy aims to connect with female voters and reinforce a family image, with Fernanda gaining more visibility in the campaign. The team also previewed sensitive topics like corruption allegations and political relationships.

item.title: Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Caiado e Augusto Cury estreiam propaganda eleitoral no rádio e na TV; veja estratégias
item.description: Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Caiado, and Augusto Cury debut their free electoral advertising on radio and TV, with slots ranging from 35 seconds to 5 minutes and 31 seconds. Campaigns feature distinct strategies: Lula emphasizes his trajectory and proposals like income tax exemption up to R$5,000, while Flávio focuses on economy and public security. The content includes mutual criticism and family presentations.

item.title: Em Angra, Flávio Bolsonaro defende Angra 3 e licenças para obras de resorts
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro advocates prioritizing the energy sector in his potential government, with expanded nuclear generation, incentives for oil and gas exploration, and streamlining environmental licenses for infrastructure works. During an event in Angra dos Reis, the senator also defended the construction of Angra 3 plant and reducing environmental bureaucracy for resort and tourism projects.

item.title: Haddad diz que apoio de tucanos é 'simbólico' e chama Flávio Bolsonaro de 'fraude'
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) deemed symbolic the support from former PSDB secretaries and called Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) a fraud, criticizing his environmental stance. He highlighted convergences like national sovereignty and human rights, while promising more reservoirs and urban integration in São Paulo.

item.title: Lula inicia horário eleitoral em situação desconfortável, afirma cientista político
item.description: Lula begins the electoral period at a disadvantage, with disapproval rates exceeding approval in polls, amid investigations involving his son and allies. Political scientist Adriano Cerqueira notes the difficulty of improving his image, even with economic measures announced. His campaign will be crucial to reverse the unfavorable standing.

item.title: Governo Lula anuncia exportações do agro para mais três países
item.description: The Lula government announced new agricultural export agreements to Costa Rica, Malaysia, and Nigeria, authorizing exports of wheat seeds, dried clove flower, and apples. Since January 2023, the Ministry of Agriculture has opened 678 new markets for Brazilian agribusiness.

item.title: Justiça de SP nega recurso do governo e mantém agências em contrato de comunicação
item.description: The São Paulo State Court rejected an appeal filed by the Tarcísio de Freitas administration, keeping the Cálix advertising agency in the bidding for the State Communication Secretariat. The ruling confirms the agency's participation in the procurement process without changes to the current terms.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro faz motociata e barqueata em Angra e defende ‘destravar amarras ambientais’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held a motorcycle parade and boat party in Angra dos Reis, advocating for loosening environmental and bureaucratic constraints, supporting oil exploration in the mouth of the Rio Amazon and the Angra 3 nuclear plant. During the event, a boat collided with a fire department water scooter without injuries. Flávio also announced Cláudio Lottenberg as Minister of Health, promising technology and AI in the SUS.

item.title: Lula diz estar mais forte e preparado para comandar o país
item.description: Lula claims he is stronger and more prepared to govern in 2026, highlighting social achievements and criticizing the PL. The PT's campaign ad presents Flávio Bolsonaro's resume, questioning his ethics and experiences. The video reinforces Lula's historical trajectory and pledges such as cost reductions and fighting organized crime.

item.title: Em estreia do horário eleitoral na TV, Flávio encenou o homem de família e Lula, o líder do ‘povo’
item.description: In the debut of electoral advertising, Flávio Bolsonaro assumed the image of a family man to attract moderate voters, while Lula reinforced his role as leader of the people, directly attacking his opponent with the phrase 'the worst of the Bolsonaros'. Both followed polling-based strategies, addressing issues such as security, inflation, and quality of life, but Flávio needs to deepen his messaging to effectively compete with the PT candidate.

item.title: Candidato pela 4ª vez pelo PCO, Rui Costa Pimenta defende armar população e dissolver PM
item.description: Rui Costa Pimenta, running for the fourth time by the PCO, advocates arming the population and dissolving the Military Police. He questions the effectiveness of the traditional electoral process in Brazil, highlighting his campaign trail since 2006.

item.title: Na TV, Lula fala em País destruído após Bolsonaro; Flávio traça perfil próprio
item.description: On the first day of free electoral time, Lula criticized the Bolsonaro government, describing the country as 'destroyed' and launched a new campaign slogan. Flávio Dino began his political trajectory with his own speeches, differentiating himself from traditional petismo.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que Flávio participará de seu programa eleitoral
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) announced that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) will participate in his election campaign TV programs, including future recordings and mutual appearances. Tarcísio also commented on the 'Dark Horse' case, stating that Flávio has already clarified the funding he received from Daniel Vorcaro for the film about former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro defende destravar licenças ambientais para liberar obras de resorts em Angra
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro used Angra dos Reis as a stage to criticize the Angra 3 nuclear plant and advocate for unblocking environmental licenses to speed up resort construction, reinforcing an infrastructure agenda with private initiative. During a parade, he emphasized reviewing municipal master plans to enable large developments in the region. The agenda reinforces his more moderated approach, focusing on economic development proposals.

item.title: Lula mira mulheres, já celebra fim da 6 X 1 e chama Marisa de Janja
item.description: Lula attended the 'Women with Lula' event in Belo Horizonte, emphasizing the importance of female voters and celebrating the approval of the 6x1 workday reduction. During his speech, he mistakenly confused the names of Duque Lula and Janja.
